## Shape of the morning

Day 5 is deliberately short. **One hour** of revision, then the room belongs to the
participants. Nothing new is taught today.

| Time | Session | Material |
|---|---|---|
| 09:30–10:30 | **Revision — the week in one hour** | [`01-week-in-review.qmd`](01-week-in-review.qmd) |
| 10:30–10:45 | Tea | — |
| 10:45–12:45 | Group presentations | [`02-group-presentation-brief.qmd`](02-group-presentation-brief.qmd) |
| 12:45–13:00 | Evaluation, certificates, closing | `../../instructor/pre-training-evaluation.xlsx` (post form) |

::: {.callout-important}
## The one-hour rule
The revision hour is a *recap and troubleshooting* slot, not a sixth teaching day.
If a topic needs more than five minutes, it goes on the follow-up list rather than
into the hour.
:::

## What the revision hour covers

The whole week is one pipeline. The hour walks it once, end to end, in about ten
minutes per link, leaving twenty minutes for open Q&A:

1. **Acquire** — `read_csv()`, `haven`, APIs, `pdftools`, `rvest` *(Day 1)*
2. **Wrangle** — the dplyr verbs, `.by=`, `join_by()`, pivots, AI-assisted cleaning *(Day 1)*
3. **Measure** — indicators, weights, `gt`/`gtsummary`, CPI splicing and index numbers *(Day 2)*
4. **See** — ggplot2, plotly, gganimate *(Day 2)*
5. **Model & map** — regression with survey weights, `sf`, `tmap`, `leaflet` *(Day 3)*
6. **Report** — Quarto, parameterised rendering, dashboards *(Day 4)*
